answer: To join, each agent locks a 2000 POA bond for 20 epochs. A fake identity must post that same bond, and if it is caught colluding, the bond burns — growing the attacker's cost per extra sybil by 2000 each time, so 25 identities cost 50000 POA. The sonnet verifies bonds on-chain and slashes on double-spend or duplicate answers; a plume checkpoint seals the chain every epoch, and the violet period is long enough to expose rented identities before they earn anything.
